[Opening: Show an AI agent chatting as the conversation grows into a long scroll.]
An AI agent can work with you through a long conversation, building up context as it goes.

[Show the scroll pressing against the edge of a frame.]
But the model can only take in so much conversation at once. That limit is called its window.

[Show the long scroll folding into a short note.]
When the conversation gets too big, it’s compressed into a summary. The agent carries on using that summary as its starting point.

[Show a few details fading away as the note is written.]
That helps the work continue, but there’s a catch: details that don’t make it into the summary are gone. The agent may forget a decision, a reason, or a small detail you expected it to remember.

[Show someone asking the agent about earlier work, then checking its answer.]
So a good summary needs a check. Ask the agent questions about the earlier work. If it can answer accurately, the summary is carrying the important details forward.

[Closing: The agent continues with the summary beside it.]
A summary is how an agent keeps going after a long session. Checking it helps make sure the right things came along.
